title: Tenant key access provenance collector for compliance reporting
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a tenant-scoped provenance collector that aggregates KMS/HSM key access events, signed attestation artifacts, and residency metadata into tamper-evident bundles suitable for compliance reporting. This collector will normalize vendor-specific audit streams (Cloud KMS, AWS CloudHSM logs, Azure Key Vault audit events), tag events with tenant residency and retention policy, and emit evidence packages consumed by the compliance evidence pipeline.
suggested_implementation: 1) Agent-based log forwarder per-region to pull KMS/HSM audit streams (CloudWatch Logs, Event Hubs, HSM syslogs) with pluggable parsers. 2) Normalizer service that maps vendor fields to canonical schema (timestamp, key_id, tenant_id, operation, outcome, requester_ip, region, residency_tag, rotation_marker). 3) Sign-and-bundle step: sign JSONL with internal signing key, attach key residency claim (signed by regional attestor), and store in immutable evidence store (WORM S3 path + checksum index). 4) Reporting API that returns per-tenant evidence bundles and a human-readable PDF summary for compliance reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Collector ingests KMS/HSM events from at least AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM, and GCP KMS in testnet
Normalized event schema validated by schema-tests with <1% rejected samples
Evidence bundles are signed and verifiable using the internal attestation key
Per-tenant residency tag present on every event and used to filter reports
Automated daily generation of evidence packages for a sample tenant stored in private-2025.03 evidence bucket
Integration tests exercising key rotation lifecycle: key-create -> rotate -> access -> evidence contains rotation markers
